description_summary: Audit pnpm lock changes and npm package bytes for supply-chain risks, lifecycle effects, publisher changes and advisories. Use after dependency changes, on lockfile PRs, or to preview candidates without installation.
should_trigger: Audit the pnpm lock dependency graph for supply-chain risks.
Inspect package tarballs and verify their locked integrity before installation.
Compare dependency risk between this base commit and the new lock.
Run an offline dependency audit using recorded registry fixtures.
Check lifecycle scripts, advisories and unexpected package origins.
should_trigger_test: Keep the audit incomplete when required source coverage is unavailable.
Audit aliases and workspace dependencies without treating local packages as registry downloads.
should_not_trigger: Update compatible dependency patches in the web workspace and verify them.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Implement a transactional write using the existing Drizzle repository adapter.
Implement the web session mutation through the existing Server Action.
Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
